levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than three genuinely different ideas are listed, or the criteria comparison is skipped or applied to only one idea.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three distinct ideas are listed and each is checked against all three criteria (helps the household, nothing bought, matches a known skill).

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains a specific tradeoff between two of their ideas before choosing.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The chosen contribution and the named beneficiary are vague or the stated reason does not connect to any of the three criteria.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The choice is justified by a specific criterion, and a specific household member and specific benefit are named.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner accurately names which part of the rest of the project they expect to be hardest, with a reason.

lookFors: The three ideas belong to genuinely different categories, not the same task worded three ways.
The chosen contribution requires nothing bought and does not assume a specific room, tool, or family structure.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
